videos.headline: Jackson makes no-look pass for UConn bucket
videos.description: Andre Jackson makes a great no-look pass to Adama Sanogo for the UConn layup.

videos.headline: Whaley throws down Huskies' dunk
videos.description: Tyrese Martin feeds it to Isaiah Whaley for the UConn dunk as they lead vs. Depaul.

videos.headline: Jones knocks down 3-pointer for DePaul

videos.headline: Martin exhibits great effort for UConn layup
videos.description: Tyrese Martin gets the rebound and does a great job to grab the layup as the Huskies pad their lead vs. DePaul.

videos.headline: DePaul's Johnson gets and-1 bucket

videos.headline: Jackson knocks down floater for Huskies

news.headline: Chris Holtmann, DePaul agree to contract extension
news.description: DePaul coach Chris Holtmann has agreed to a contract extension that runs through the 2030-31 season.
